technical_and_design_decisions: Baseline stack: Java 17, Spring Boot 3.x, Spring Framework 6.x, Spring Cloud Stream 4.x using the functional programming model (java.util.function.Consumer for sink modules), built as a Maven multi-module project with a shared BOM.

Each module is delivered as a standalone Spring Boot application (app starter) with dedicated auto-configuration and @ConfigurationProperties metadata, following a canonical layout: auto-config jar, app jar, tests, and README.

A shared analytics support library (port of XD's counter/gauge repositories with in-memory and Redis implementations) is extracted first and reused by the field-value-counter, aggregate-counter, gauge, and rich-gauge sinks to avoid duplicated logic.

Kinesis sink (U1) is implemented on AWS SDK for Java v2 Kinesis async client with configurable stream name, partition-key strategy, batching, retries/backoff, and Micrometer metrics; integration tests run against LocalStack via Testcontainers.

Job DSL (U3) is implemented as a grammar for sequential, parallel and conditional job composition, with a parser producing an AST/graph model, validation, and execution through the Spring Cloud Data Flow composed-task runner; exposed via REST and shell commands; no UI work included.

Flink processor (U8) embeds the Apache Flink DataStream runtime managed by the Spring Boot lifecycle, with a local execution environment for tests, Kryo serialization, configurable checkpointing, and a small SPI to plug in streaming machine-learning algorithms; packaging as an executable uber-jar.
Error handling uses Spring Cloud Stream error channels/DLQ support; observability via Micrometer and Spring Boot Actuator across all modules.

Testing strategy: JUnit 5 unit tests, Spring integration tests, and Testcontainers-based tests (Redis, LocalStack, Kafka test binder) included within each module's estimate; CI on GitHub Actions with artifact publishing to a Maven repository.
assumptions: The existing Spring XD modules (log, field-value-counter, aggregate-counter, gauge, rich-gauge) are available as reference implementations and must be functionally equivalent after porting, with configuration mapped to idiomatic Spring Boot properties.
Acceptance criteria per module are derivable from the XD module documentation and behavior; no additional formal requirements documentation is required.
Build infrastructure (source repository, CI workers, artifact repository) already exists; only project/module scaffolding needs to be created.
AWS, Redis, and messaging infrastructure for testing is provided through Testcontainers/local emulators; no cloud account provisioning work is included.
Kinesis sink targets Amazon Kinesis Data Streams only (not Kinesis Firehose or DynamoDB Streams).
Job DSL scope is limited to the DSL definition, parser, validation, and server-side orchestration integration; no web UI or monitoring dashboards are in scope.
Flink processor scope is limited to embedded/local execution plus packaging; production cluster deployment, HA tuning and performance certification are out of scope.

One developer performs all work; estimates are pure effort (work-hours), not elapsed duration, and each module activity includes design, implementation, unit/integration tests, code review rework, and module-level documentation.
Documentation scope is per-module README plus reference documentation snippets and a small set of runnable samples; no full documentation portal overhaul.
Spring Cloud Data Flow server (or equivalent orchestration endpoint) is available as the target for the Job DSL integration tests.

activities.activity_description: Analyze the source XD modules and the Kinesis/Flink/Job-DSL requirements; define porting approach, configuration property conventions, shared analytics abstraction, and DSL grammar draft; produce lightweight design notes per module.
Create Maven multi-module structure, parent POMs, BOM, dependency management, code style/checks, GitHub Actions CI pipeline, and module scaffolding template for the s-c-s app starters.

Port the counter/gauge repository abstractions from XD (in-memory and Redis implementations, metric value models) into a reusable library consumed by the counter and gauge sinks; includes unit and Redis integration tests.
Port the XD log module to an s-c-s sink (consumer) with configurable log level/name/expression, auto-configuration, properties metadata, unit and binder integration tests, and README.

Implement a new Kinesis Data Streams sink: AWS SDK v2 async producer, partition-key and batching configuration, retry/backoff and error handling, Micrometer metrics, LocalStack-based integration tests, properties metadata, and documentation.

Port the field-value-counter module onto the shared analytics library, including field-name SpEL extraction, store selection (in-memory/Redis), auto-configuration, unit and integration tests, and README.
Port the aggregate-counter module (increment/decrement with time-bucketed aggregation semantics) onto the shared analytics library, with auto-configuration, unit and integration tests, and README.
Port the gauge module (record latest numeric value) onto the shared analytics library, with auto-configuration, unit and integration tests, and README.
Port the rich-gauge module (value plus running min/max/mean/count) onto the shared analytics library, with auto-configuration, unit and integration tests, and README.

Design and implement the job orchestration DSL: grammar for sequential/parallel/conditional composition, parser to AST/graph, validation and error reporting, mapping to composed-task definitions, integration with the orchestration server REST API, shell/endpoint exposure, comprehensive parser and integration tests, and documentation.

Implement the Flink-based processor: embedded Flink DataStream runtime with Spring Boot lifecycle management, message-to-DataStream mapping, Kryo serialization, checkpointing configuration, streaming-ML plug-in SPI, uber-jar packaging, local-environment tests, and documentation.

Build and run end-to-end streaming pipeline tests combining the delivered sinks/processors with a test binder (Kafka) and external services (Redis, LocalStack Kinesis); verify Job DSL orchestration flows; triage and fix defects found.
Write reference documentation sections for all modules and the Job DSL/Flink features, plus runnable sample stream and job definitions demonstrating each user story.
Version and tag the increment, publish artifacts to the Maven repository, generate release notes, and perform final build reproducibility checks.
